note: Code map: gathers the reproduction code that already exists in the workspace into code/, grouped by its position in the paper.
This file is the sole input to code/sync.py and code/verify.py; it is maintained by hand.
source paths are relative to the repository root; target paths are relative to the code/ directory.
authoritative_root is always experiment_root — code/ is only a traceable archive mirror/entry point,
so sync.py only copies and never moves or deletes any file under experiment_root
(experiment_root's audit/freeze_manifest.json records the hashes of the tool source code,
and moving anything would directly break the frozen package's tree digest).

why: fetch_repos.py is the only script among all the reproduction code that locates its own cache directory via __file__:
once copied into code/, __file__ would point to code/01_infra_noncontainer/,
and the script would create _inventory/_snapshots there, diverging from the frozen repo_cache.
Therefore one line-level adaptation is applied to the copy of this file: pin CACHE to the authoritative repo_cache.
Not one line of logic is changed; the adaptation is recorded in the adaptation field of CODE_INDEX.json.
path_pin.replace: CACHE = r"{repo_cache}"  # code-tree adapter: pin to the authoritative cache
